subject: Still waiting on my coffee machine refund
body: Hi, I bought a coffee machine from your Suzhou Industrial Park store a few weeks back. I ended up returning it because it kept leaking water all over the counter, and I was told the refund would be processed. That was a while ago now and I still haven't seen the money back on my card. I've checked my statements twice. I bought it mainly because I work from home and wanted decent coffee without going out, so this has been a hassle I didn't need. Can someone look into where the refund is stuck? I'd appreciate an update.
